name: disk_usage
description: Show disk space usage for all drives with bar chart
task_prompt:
Write a Python script to show disk usage for every mounted partition.
Use psutil.disk_partitions() and psutil.disk_usage().
For each drive print:
  Drive | Total GB | Used GB | Free GB | Usage% | [ASCII bar 20 chars]
Bar: filled with '█', empty with '░'. Example: ████████░░░░░░░░░░░░ 43%
Skip drives that raise PermissionError. Print grand total at the end.
